name: Rotating Platform
description: A 2×2 plate whose central propeller spins on every pick, pushing the boxes around so the one you need rotates in and out of reach.
howToPlay: Every time you pick ANY box, the propeller in the middle of the plate turns 90° anti-clockwise and pushes its four boxes one cell around the ring. The pink box starts walled in — pick the green and blue boxes (or the yellow ones below) to spin the pink box around to the open bottom-right cell, then grab it. Sort every colour to win.
author: Marble Sorter Prototyping
